messages.content: Write a 700-word short story about a lighthouse keeper who discovers the light has started answering back. Literary, restrained, no dialogue tags beyond 'said'.

Continue this passage in the same voice for about 400 words:

The train did not so much arrive as concede the station, exhaling a long mechanical sigh as though it too were tired of the journey. Marren stepped down onto a platform the color of old teeth.

Rewrite this paragraph in the terse, punchy style of hardboiled detective fiction, keeping the facts: 'It was a pleasant afternoon and I decided, after some deliberation, that I would walk down to the small cafe on the corner to enjoy a coffee and perhaps read the newspaper for a while.'
Write a 12-line poem about a city at 4am. No rhyme required. Concrete imagery only.
